title: AgentOrchestrator task definition
description: Structural contract for the YAML frontmatter of one task file in a repository’s MARKDOWN_DIRECTORY task source. Generated from the Zod schema in src/plan/task-definition.ts by `npm run schema:generate` — do not edit by hand. This is the *static plan*, not the runtime state: it is deliberately unrelated to task-state.schema.json, shares no field with it, and carries no schema version because it is read from a repository rather than persisted by the orchestrator. Cross-field invariants (a duplicate-free dependsOn list, no self-dependency) and the task-id grammar beyond "a string" are NOT expressible in JSON Schema and are enforced only by TaskDefinitionSchema at runtime. Graph-wide rules — unique ids, dependencies that resolve, no cycles — belong to src/plan/task-graph.ts and are not properties of a single document at all.
